q: In the model-monitoring project, what do we know about q-mm-psi-threshold?
a: It asks which PSI bar should page on-call and on which signal. The 2025 answer was a page at 0.25 on feature or score PSI (dec-mm-page-threshold). It was replaced in February 2026 by a page at 0.20 on score PSI, with feature PSI at 0.25 diagnostic only (dec-mm-page-threshold-2026).

q: In the model-monitoring project, what came of exp-203, the score-PSI lead-time test?
a: Score PSI crossed 0.10 a median 6 days before the label rate moved, against 3 days for feature PSI. That led to fnd-score-psi-leads and to dec-mm-score-first, which made score PSI the primary alert.

q: In the model-monitoring project, what does mm-limit-glm-v2 depend on for its features and its drift reference?
a: Its features include feat-mm-util-trend-6m and feature-store-migration/feat-fsm-util-ratio. Drift is checked against the same-month-last-year reference from ds-mm-reference-train, as set by dec-mm-seasonal-reference.

q: In the model-monitoring project, which collections propensity model version is current, and which payment-ratio feature does it read?
a: mm-collect-xgb-v2, which reads feat-mm-payment-ratio-v2 and has AUC 0.741 on mm-oot-2024h2. It replaced mm-collect-xgb-v1, which read feat-mm-payment-ratio-v1.

q: In the model-monitoring project, how many of the 19 labelled incidents did the score-PSI 0.20 page rule catch, and how many false pages did it make?
a: 18 of 19 incidents, with 3 false pages, from the replay in exp-207. The feature-PSI 0.25 rule caught 16 with 4 false pages (exp-202).

q: In the model-monitoring project, why did the payment-ratio PSI jump to 0.31 in February 2025?
a: It was not customer drift. The minimum-due formula changed on the first scoring day of January 2025, which was a definition change. It was fixed by feat-mm-payment-ratio-v2 (fnd-payment-ratio-bug).
